propositions: Closed bugs lacking close_class must be backfilled using only structural signals: revert of STATUS/COMMITS event infers regression, plan-review BLOCK infers plan_defect, gate_error_v1 ERROR infers env_integration, otherwise undetermined
Backfilled records must be written to .rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified, separate from authoritative close_class values
The backfill script must be idempotent by ticket_id: skip bugs already in the artifact and bugs with existing authoritative close_class
Revert signals must filter for substantive target_event_type (STATUS or COMMITS), not COMMENT or LINK, to qualify as regression
Gate error detection requires raw event-file scan of *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json files for gate_error_v1 schema, since all_review_results schema guard rejects it
Plan-review BLOCK signals must be read via all_review_results with verdict==BLOCK check, accounting for retention caps of 50 results per ticket
